useCasesHub.metaTitle: Run Your Small Business with AI | Duet
useCasesHub.metaDescription: Build apps, triage inboxes, draft support, run reports, and keep review rules in one AI workspace for your small business.
useCasesHub.ogAlt: Run your small business with AI — Duet
useCasesHub.heroTagline: Operate like a giant. Stay lean.
useCasesHub.heroBody: You don't need a bigger team. You need a teammate that keeps working in the cloud. Duet is a cloud workspace where small businesses run on AI — your coworker lives on its own server, remembers context, builds what you ask for, and continues recurring workflows in the cloud.
useCasesHub.categoriesBody: There are three categories of AI products today. Small businesses can struggle to tell them apart, which is why AI spend can drift into point tools. The gap between an AI tool and an AI coworker is the gap between a calculator and an operating checklist — one does the arithmetic, the other keeps the process moving.
useCasesHub.leanStackHeadingLead: Three new capabilities a small business gets
useCasesHub.byRoleBody: Every small business runs differently. The pages below walk through the jobs the people in each role hand off first — with the actual prompts they send, the outcomes they get back, and the answers to the questions every team asks before they hire.
useCasesHub.byJobHeadingLead: 12 things a small business can hand to its
useCasesHub.byJobBodyLead: Browse the full job tree at
useCasesHub.byJobBodyTrail: , or jump straight to the one that eats your week.
useCasesHub.featuredBody: A scan-friendly tour of the work Duet does most. Each row is a real job a real team handed off this quarter — follow the link to see the prompt, the outcome, and three more like it.
useCasesHub.chooseBody: AI tools are often point solutions. Duet is the layer underneath. If your problem is "I want to write a poem about my dog" — use ChatGPT. If your problem is "I'm a freelance consultant trying to run a business while doing the actual work" — that's what Duet is for.
useCasesHub.builtBody: We use Duet to run our own company — newsletters, support, sales, ops, internal apps, all on one Duet workspace. We didn't build a product for the Fortune 500. We built the tool we wished we had as a five-person company trying to ship like a fifty-person company.
useCasesHub.hubFinalBody: You don't need a bigger team. You need a teammate who runs on schedules, from triggers, and between review passes while you're with customers.

faq.heading: The short answers.
faq.q1: How do the monthly plans work?
faq.a1: Starter, Pro, and Max each include monthly credits. That bucket resets at renewal, and unused monthly credits do not roll over.
faq.q2: What happens if I use all my monthly credits?
faq.a2: Duet keeps working from your paid credit reserve. Fund it with a manual topup or let auto topup keep it ready for overage.
faq.q3: What happens after the free trial?
faq.a3: The trial lasts 7 days. Choose an active subscription to keep running charged work after it ends.
faq.q4: When do plan changes take effect?
faq.a4: Upgrades apply immediately. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.
faq.a5: Yes. Every charge produces a customer-visible Stripe invoice, including subscription renewals and reserve topups.
faq.q6: How do the AI tiers work?
faq.a6: Duet routes each task within the outcome tier you choose. Each tier has flat input, output, and cached-input token rates.
faq.a7: Yes. Each agent runs in an isolated sandbox on a private single-tenant cloud server with encrypted credentials and network isolation. We never train on your data.
